path_prefixes.description: Expensive endpoints watched for first-time visitors, matched with starts_with on the request path (query included), e.g. /cgi-bin/koha/opac-search.pl, /catalogsearch/.

window_secs.description: Sliding window for counting fresh IPs. Default 300.

fresh_ip_memory_secs.description: An IP (IPv6: /ipv6_prefix) seen with any HTTP request within this period is not fresh. Default 86400.

fresh_ip_threshold.description: Under attack when MORE than this many fresh IPs hit path_prefixes in the window. Default 30.

off_threshold.description: Back to normal when fewer than this many fresh IPs per window for cooldown_secs; must be <= fresh_ip_threshold. Default fresh_ip_threshold / 3.

cooldown_secs.description: How long the count must stay below off_threshold before the state turns off. Default 900.

max_tracked_ips.description: Memory bound for remembered IPs and candidates. Default 500000.

exclude_static_fetchers.description: An IP that fetches a static asset (static_extensions) within the window is treated as a browser and not counted. Default true.

static_extensions.description: Static asset suffixes (case-insensitive). Default: the http_flood ignore list (.css .js .png .woff2 …).

require_no_referer.description: Count only requests without a Referer. Needs a parser that fills metadata 'referer' (the built-in nginx parser does not yet). Default false.

ipv6_prefix.description: IPv6 sources are counted per this prefix (0 = per address, else 48..128). Default 64.

flag_file.description: File created (atomically, mode 0644) while under attack and removed afterwards; empty string = no file. Default /run/hiveguard/under_attack.

eval_interval_secs.description: How often the state is evaluated and the gauge refreshed. Default 5.
